body.heading: Where in the world is Cabo Verde?
paragraphs: Cabo Verde is a country in Western Africa, which is part of Africa. It is an island country, surrounded by sea.

body.heading: The capital city
paragraphs: The capital of Cabo Verde is Praia.

body.heading: Words you might hear
paragraphs: People in Cabo Verde speak Cape Verdean Creole and Portuguese. Cape Verdean Creole is the language of home and everyday life on the islands; Portuguese is the official language.

body.heading: Money in your pocket
paragraphs: The money of Cabo Verde is the Cape Verdean escudo.

body.heading: How big is Cabo Verde?
paragraphs: Cabo Verde covers about 4,000 square kilometres of land and inland water. That makes it about twice the size of Comoros.

body.heading: Two places we'd love to visit
paragraphs: Sal island's Santa Maria beach has soft white sand, turquoise water and colourful fishing boats — perfect for swimming, kite-surfing and watching turtles in season.
On Fogo island, a giant volcano cone rises from an ancient crater. Villages inside the crater grow coffee and grapes in the black volcanic soil.

body.heading: Think and talk
paragraphs: 1. Find Cabo Verde on a map or globe. Which continent is it nearest to — and what sea or ocean surrounds it?
2. Spark and Mango can visit only ONE of the two places in this article. Which should they choose — and what would you pack for the trip?
